a1-03.title: A busy day in town
a1-03.story: Today Anna is going [[shopping]] in Kyiv. She rides her [[bicycle]] to the [[bank]]. She gets fifty [[dollars|dollar]] for a new coat. Outside, workers are carrying big concrete [[blocks|block]]. One falls, and Anna falls off her bike. A kind [[cop]] helps her and calls a [[taxi]]. A [[doctor]] checks her foot, and it is fine. Grandpa, an old army [[officer]], laughs: "My brave girl!"

a1-04.title: A surprise weekend party
a1-04.story: This [[weekend]] is Mama's birthday. Anna has a [[plan]] for a [[surprise]] [[party]]. Taras thinks it is a [[super]] [[idea]]. Dad buys a [[cool]] cake with forty candles. Grandpa is writing a short [[speech]] for Mama. On Saturday, Mama comes home, and everyone sings. It is a [[good]] [[moment]] for Mama. She laughs and kisses Taras.

a1-05.title: Festival concert tonight
a1-05.story: There is a music [[festival]] in Kyiv tonight. Max and Lisa are at the [[concert]]. Their favorite [[band]] plays songs from its new [[album]]. Lisa has their [[CD]] in her bag. After the show, a [[reporter]] is asking people questions. She asks Lisa, "Do you like the music?" Lisa smiles and says, "Yes, I love it!" Later, Max sees Lisa on TV!

a1-06.title: A night at the theater
a1-06.story: Anna and Sofia are at the [[theater]] tonight. It is a [[drama]], not an [[opera]]. There is modern [[art]] on the walls. Sofia's favorite [[actor]] plays the [[prince]]. In the play, he loses his love. Sofia is crying, and Anna gives her a tissue. After the show, he signs Sofia's ticket! Now she is very happy.

a1-07.title: Our summer trip
a1-07.story: Anna and her family are on a summer [[trip]]. They fly to Lviv by [[aeroplane]]. They stay at a small [[hotel]] in the center. Their first [[visit]] is to an old [[palace]]. Then they have a [[picnic]] in a green field. A [[farmer]] comes and gives Taras some apples. Taras says, "Next summer, I want a farm [[camp]]!"

a1-08.title: Online at home
a1-08.story: Max is making a funny [[video]] for Anna's birthday. He wants to send it by [[email]]. But the [[internet]] is not working at home! Then the [[telephone]] rings. It is Sofia. "Use my Wi-Fi, the [[code]] is 1234," she says. Max sends the big [[file]] at last. Anna loves it and puts it on her [[site]].

a1-09.title: Max's job interview
a1-09.story: Today Max has a job [[interview]]. He goes to the [[office]] of a small [[business]]. The [[interviewer]] asks, "What [[skills|skill]] do you have?" Max shows her his [[design]] for a new phone. "This is a busy [[period]] for us," she says. "Your [[role]] is to help our team [[leader]]." "Can you start on Monday?" Max smiles and says, "Yes, I can!"

a1-10.title: A test at college
a1-10.story: Anna studies at a [[college]] in Kyiv. She is taking an English [[course]] there. Today there is a big [[test]]! Anna is a little scared. The first [[activity]] is reading a short text. Next, she writes about her favorite [[type]] of music. It is [[easy]] for Anna! She gets ten out of ten!
